canonical_source.author: Shubham Kumar
canonical_source.title: Rural Cultural Communication: Mundari Folk and Reflection of Daily Struggle
canonical_source.geographic_scope: Jharkhand and surrounding-region discussion; exact field locality not verified in this run

identity_verification.author_affiliation_as_provider_reports: Assistant Professor, Amity University, Noida, U.P.

deduplication.canonicalization_rule: HTML landing page and provider PDF, if later obtained, are manifestations of one work and must not be counted as independent corroboration. Downstream citations/index records are derivative metadata unless independently evidenced.

scope_and_evidence_controls.reason: The discoverable provider page supplies bibliographic/abstract-level evidence and advertises a downloadable PDF, but this run did not verify authoritative PDF bytes, pagination, research design, primary-source provenance, participant/performer consent, or reuse terms. Abstract assertions are therefore not promoted as timeless or universal Munda cultural facts.

rights_access_consent.read_access: provider labels full text open-access/free to read and download
rights_access_consent.rule: Public readability/downloadability is not treated as permission to redistribute, and publication is not treated as proof of participant/performer consent for dataset reuse.

required_before_proposition_promotion: obtain and hash authoritative provider PDF where lawful
verify title page, publication metadata and print/PDF pagination
inspect methodology, field locality, participant/sample and temporal scope
separate primary observations/quoted performances from secondary literature and author interpretation
review consent and cultural sensitivity for any participant speech, song, ritual or performance material

quality_notes: The provider abstract contains broad cultural assertions; none are accepted into the controlled cultural-claim ledger solely from the abstract.
The source remains potentially useful for folk-communication bibliography and exact-locator conversion after full-text provenance review.
No claim of exhaustive source completeness is made.

release_effect.why: Runs 381-600 still require deterministic reconciliation against the MMSC/WEB-MUN ledger; changing controlled counts before reconciliation would be unsupported.
